resources.string: Each action asks separately. These controls do not clear cookies, Discovery history, provider progress, bookmarks, or saved videos.
Clears the ordinary webpage visit list on this device. Existing tabs and website login sessions stay open. This cannot be undone.
Requests removal of the shared WebView memory and disk cache. Webpages may load more slowly next time. This does not clear site storage or login cookies.
Request clearing the WebView cache shared by this app’s browser tabs. The system provides no completion or freed-space report. Cookies, history, bookmarks, and saved videos are not included.
Cache clearing requested. The system does not report completion or the amount of space freed.
The cache clear request failed. No successful cleanup is confirmed; you can try again.
